summary_en: SBI Holdings' subsidiary SBINM LLC completed a tender offer for BASE Inc., acquiring 90,944 shares at 340 yen per share for approximately 30.9 million yen. The offer period ran from August 31 to October 21, 2026, with minimal subscription relative to the 23.79 million share upper limit.
title_en: Notice on Results of Tender Offer for Shares of BASE Inc. (Securities Code: 4477)
translation_en_brief:
On October 22, 2026, SBI Holdings announced the completion of a tender offer for BASE Inc. (Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth market, code 4477) conducted by SBINM LLC, a subsidiary in which SBIER K.K. (100% owned by SBI Holdings) holds all membership interests and serves as the sole managing member.

The tender offer was conducted at a purchase price of 340 yen per share, with an offer period from August 31, 2026 to October 21, 2026 (34 business days). The bidder had set an upper limit of 23,792,300 shares to be acquired. However, the actual number of shares tendered was only 90,944 shares, significantly below the upper limit. Since the total subscriptions did not exceed the upper limit, all tendered shares were purchased as planned.

The acquisition of 90,944 shares at 340 yen per share resulted in a total purchase amount of approximately 30.9 million yen. No treasury shares held by BASE Inc. were acquired, and fractional shares were included in the tender offer scope. The disclosure does not specify the percentage of outstanding shares acquired or provide reasoning for the transaction.
